responsibility: Overrides the default AVR driver specs for toolchains configured with AVR-LibC. It rewrites the library, libgcc/libm, startfile, and group-linking specs so the driver links the AVR-LibC C runtime, device-specific startup objects, and AVR-LibC’s alternative implementations of some libgcc routines in the correct order, distinguishing AVR-LibC builds from the generic AVR specs in `specs.h`.
